summary: Typing Protocol contracts for the expression layers. api_builders/ (substrait and extensions_mountainash) declare what each fluent builder must provide; expression_systems/ (substrait and extensions_mountainash) declare what each backend ExpressionSystem must implement per operation domain. Protocols are the source of truth for backend obligations and drive signature, alignment and completeness tests.
key_classes: Substrait*ExpressionSystemProtocol (prtcl_expsys_*) — per-domain backend contracts (cast, literal, field_reference, conditional, scalar_arithmetic/boolean/comparison/datetime/string/set/logarithmic/rounding, aggregates, window_arithmetic)
prtcl_expsys_ext_ma_* — Mountainash-extension backend contracts (name, null, ternary, list, struct, categorical, geospatial, window, ...)
extension_points: New operation: add protocol method here (step 2 of adding-operations) then builder, backends and function mapping
lifecycle_notes: Directory has no top-level __init__.py (namespace package); imports use full submodule paths
risks: Protocol and implementation drift; guarded by alignment/completeness/signature tests
Renaming a protocol method fans out to three backends and builders
